prompt: Sort the entry list `es` by count descending, then by key ascending, with one lambda (a, b) spread over three lines. When the two values differ (test with !b.getValue().equals(a.getValue()), because they are boxed), return Integer.compare(b.getValue(), a.getValue()); otherwise return a.getKey().compareTo(b.getKey()). Use a ternary.
why: Compare counts with b before a for descending, and use equals on the boxed Integers because == compares references.
